name: Value
blurb: The lowest-priced Disney-owned hotels. Big, brightly themed resorts with food courts instead of table-service restaurants, and buses or the Skyliner to the parks.

name: Moderate
blurb: A step up in theming, pools and dining, with more spread-out, quieter grounds. A middle ground between Value and Deluxe.

name: Deluxe
blurb: The best locations, closest to the parks, with the most restaurants, the biggest pools and more ways to get around without a bus.

name: Deluxe Villa
blurb: Disney Vacation Club resorts. You do not need to be a member to stay. Villas range from studios with a kitchenette to multi-bedroom villas with a full kitchen, which suits bigger families and longer stays.

name: Campground
blurb: Bring a tent or RV and stay in the woods, with a boat to Magic Kingdom.
